criteria.requirement: Fix timeutils.dt_to_timestamp to classify awareness by tzinfo is not None and dt.utcoffset() is not None, rather than tzinfo truthiness. Falsey tzinfo with a real offset must convert correctly; tzinfo objects returning None are naive and retain the existing implied-UTC convention. Preserve negative epochs, fractional seconds, fold-specific offsets and original offset errors; do not silently use host local timezone or alter datetime objects.
